prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: transparent PNG decorative header illustration for an iOS settings page.
Input reference: the attached settings mockup is a STYLE and SUBJECT reference only. Extract/reinterpret just the upper-right vignette as a standalone asset, NOT a screenshot.
Create a refined pixel-art brass reading lamp casting soft warm amber light onto a short stack of two worn books on a thin dark wooden ledge, with a few subdued trailing green leaves behind it. The lamp and books should be the main content; compact landscape composition 3:2. Match the finely detailed lofi pixel-art texture and gentle warmth of the reference. Objects must be fully contained, no cut-off lamp shade. Keep perimeter leaves dark and understated so it blends into a near-black app page. Actual transparent background outside objects, including gentle translucent light falloff. No black rectangle, no full room, no city, no girl, no text, no UI, no frame, no watermark. This is a small tasteful decorative vignette, not an icon tile.
